description: Makes the video for a draft. It creates the listing and uses one of the account's listing credits, exactly like making it in the Reel-E app. A connection that may create listings starts it now and gets the listingId; any other connection gets an approveUrl for the account owner, who approves it in Reel-E, and get_listing_status shows progress. Calling it again does not make a second listing.
name: start_video
title: Make the video
